```{r}
#| label: cvevents
cvevents <- function(tbl, period, title, company, city, details) {
  command_start <- "\\cvevent"

  res <- paste0(
    command_start, "{", tbl[[period]], "}", 
    "{", tbl[[title]], "}",
    "{", tbl[[company]], "}",
    "{", tbl[[city]], "}")
  
  tbl[[details]] <- sapply(tbl[[details]], function(x) paste0("{", x, "}", collapse = ","))
  res <- paste0(res, "{",tbl[[details]],"}")

  cat(res, sep = "\n")
}
```
